rows.object: their faith in fundamental human rights, in the dignity and worth of the human person and in the equal rights of men and women
rows.because: RE-TYPED 2026-08-31 (was REC·Figure). A held commitment restated, not a frame replaced: the object is literally "their faith", and reaffirming binds the holder to it again — Relate·Interpretation, whose engine stance name is Binding. REC is Generate·Interpretation, the re-zero (converted, recanted, revised), and it concedes a prior ground; reaffirmation concedes nothing, so "produces an existing commitment anew" was self-contradictory in this algebra. "in the Charter" is adjunct (A2)
